title: SuPER-Mamba: Surprisal Prioritization for Extended-Context Routing in Mamba
abstract: arXiv:2610.16636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: State space models provide efficient linear-complexity processing for long sequences, but their performance frequently degrades as context length grows. We propose SuPER-Mamba, a training-free framework that uses Surprisal as a model-intrinsic signal for long-range state routing in pretrained Mamba models. SuPER-Mamba computes position-wise Surprisal from next-token predictions, aggregates neighboring responses through Local Pooling, and uses the resulting scores to prioritize Global-Channel updates without query-dependent scoring or additional training. We evaluate SuPER-Mamba on three state-space models across the LongBench-E benchmark. The results show that SuPER-Mamba improves the average score from 8.06 to 15.69, corresponding to a 94.7% relative gain over the Base Models and a 13.1% improvement over the state-of-the-art prior baseline. translated_title: SuPER-Mamba：基于惊讶度优先排序的Mamba扩展上下文路由
translated_abstract: 状态空间模型为长序列提供了高效的线性复杂度处理能力，但其性能往往随着上下文长度的增长而下降。我们提出了SuPER-Mamba，这是一个无需训练的框架，它将“惊讶度”作为模型内在信号，用于预训练Mamba模型中的长程状态路由。SuPER-Mamba从下一个词预测中计算逐位置的惊讶度，通过局部池化聚合相邻响应，并利用所得分数对全局通道更新进行优先排序，无需查询相关的评分或额外训练。我们在LongBench-E基准上对三个状态空间模型评估了SuPER-Mamba。结果表明，SuPER-Mamba将平均分数从8.06提升至15.69，相对于基础模型实现了94.7%的相对提升，并比最先进的先验基线方法提高了13.1%。消融实验和按长度的分析进一步验证了所提出路由框架的有效性。
tldr: SuPER-Mamba是一种无需训练的框架，利用模型内在的“惊讶度”信号对预训练Mamba模型进行长程状态路由，在LongBench-E基准上将平均分数从8.06提升至15.69，相比基础模型提升94.7%。
